as_told.title: Immaculate Constellation report: triangle ARVs over Indo-PACOM

plain: Slowly rotating triangles were seen over the area watched by Indo-Pacific Command, the US military's command for the Pacific and Asia, according to a document called Immaculate Constellation that the researcher known as UAPGerb attributes to a man named Matthew Brown. UAPGerb, summarising the document, elsewhere describes them as equilateral triangles with three lights over Chinese territory, and calls them adversarial "alien reproduction vehicles", meaning craft built by a rival nation in imitation of alien ones. If true, a foreign power would be flying such craft and the US military would know it.
